video_title: Gilbert Arenas says he REALLY wanted the SMOKE with John Wall

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his competitive mindset while playing in Orlando
quotes.excerpt: I'm neutralizing in Orlando. So when I get back to DC, I'm on demon time.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: Your shin was hurting in Orlando too? Your shin was aching you in Orlando? Because I've seen the few games you got busy in Orlando.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: No, it was more so much stuff was happening. Just got off the gun thing. You see me in Chicago, right? So what happened is I'm neutralizing in Orlando. So when I get back to DC, I'm on demon time. Grew the hair. John Wall, check that stuff up. He getting mopped.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas explains his tactical approach to playing against John Wall
quotes.excerpt: He's a right-handed that want to go left. So he jump off his right foot.
quotes.quote: That number one pick, I mean, I mopped him. I watched film on him. I'm like, he's a right-handed that want to go left. So he jump off his right foot, and two-foot jumps off his left with the lean, so he don't have the same power as a righty. I'm like, I'm going to just push him towards his right. People going to think I'm stupid. So I already got this guy down. Meet this guy for the first time, I said, 'Oh, Gil, what's up, OG?' I threw your whole shit off, man. I'm a big fan, dog. I can't wait to play with you, OG.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his frustration with the Washington Wizards organization
quotes.excerpt: I'm on demon time, man. I'm mad at the whole situation, mad at the organization.
quotes.quote: I'm on demon time, man. I'm mad at the whole situation, mad at the organization, man. I'm making everybody pay. And then the dude that's replacing me is like, 'Man, the NBA, man, what's up, man?' I'm like, this is you, dog. This is you. Whatever you need, boss hog, I'm good, man. You don't have to worry about like, I'm adapting to you. How you play the game, where you want me at, that's where it's at, man. This ain't my shit, this is you. It's all you. I'm not even going to be in your way, big dog. And that's how I went into it. But when I got to Orlando, it was more like, it ain't my place. Like this the white place. Like I can't come in and, 'Hey man, hey coach, man, get the fuck out my way, man. What's up?' Like so every time he was forced to play me, like so like J. Rich is out, J.J. Redick out, I'm not, it's just me and Duhan, and he got to play us. Like see, popping my shit.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Jameer Nelson's role in Orlando
quotes.excerpt: Jameer Nelson was this guy. That man Jameer sacrificed. He done went through the mud with you.
quotes.quote: Jameer Nelson was this guy. That man Jameer sacrificed. He done went through the mud with you, everything. You can't just say and just come in, I'm going to just play. No. I even told Jameer, like you know how you see like that that unsettling like, 'Ah man, like this kind of shit looking a little stressful out there in the shot,' like, 'Hey, hey, hey, bro. I'm coming off the bench, man. I work the second unit. This is your team.' Because if we got him as the leading point guard, like thinking about like getting yanked out the lineup because the papers writing it, like no, like our unit, you got that unit, J. Rich and them, is me, J.J. Redick, Ryan Nelson, like we good over here. Don't worry about it. I'm not coming for your position. I'm cool with where I'm at.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on being the first NBA player served child support on court
quotes.excerpt: I was the first NBA player to get served child support on the court.
quotes.quote: I got served on the in on national TV. I was the first NBA player to get served child support on the court. Walking at halftime. Missed arenas, what up, man? You think it is the reporter. Nigga, this is a server. I'm thinking I'm about to sign some autograph. I've been served. You like, what the fuck? Nigga, stop the game. I look at my phone, man, they were like, 'Did you just get served child support papers on the court?' I was like, yep.
